methodology.direction: full native union-task wall divided by missing native directions
methodology.frame: matched warm complete run minus fixed startup/catalog, divided by native frames
methodology.efficiency: one/two-worker matched warm work after fixed costs; capped at 1
methodology.startup_catalog: fixed engineering allowance checked against phase/whole-run timings
methodology.excluded: planning/submission and OS-cache flush; run API includes final verification
methodology.memory_disk: conservative V1 allocation and uncompressed bytes plus temporary/metadata headroom
methodology.uncalibrated_terms: media, final hits and four-worker costs are provisional
methodology.component_revision: Separate measured directional and output concurrency; classification split from frame cost. Derived only from calibration, before any hold-out outcomes.
